_readme: Bottle profile: Owala FreeSip Tumbler, 40 oz, Coral Cabana (special edition; cream with navy coral, starfish and shells over stripes). All lengths in mm. Any key from params.json can be added here to override it for this bottle.

bottle._note: ESTIMATES, not measured. Owala gives 11.64 in tall x 3.60 in (91 mm) across at the widest; the base narrows to fit cup holders, about 2.75-2.85 in (70-72 mm) by Owala's Q&A answers. Measure with calipers before the full print; check for a step or shoulder in the bottom 40 mm, which this straight taper does not model.
bottle._BASE_DIAMETER: Side of the bottle just above the rounded bottom edge
bottle._UPPER_DIAMETER: Side of the bottle at UPPER_HEIGHT above the table
bottle._UPPER_HEIGHT: Where UPPER_DIAMETER is measured, from the table. Above WALL_HEIGHT
bottle._CORNER_RADIUS: Rounded edge between the bottom and the side
